text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that links the conditional scene to the prior offender profile while beginning a fresh diagnostic case

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: temporal-conditional particle that turns the linked continuation into a repeatable exposure frame

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 45:9 attached to the hostile profile just described in 45:8, so the ayah does not open as a detached scene. Joined to {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}), it both continues the boundary and reopens the case as a repeatable diagnostic condition: when knowledge arrives, the response exposes the person. The light opening cadence makes the hinge quick before the heavier sequence of knowing, signs, and mockery begins.

topics.headline: linked continuation into a new test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is both continuing the prior hostile profile (45:8) and reopening it as a new conditional test.
topics.reason: QAC marks the prefixed conjunction before the conditional particle, and attachment evidence treats the following span as the protasis for the response clause.

topics.headline: boundary launch before exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah inherit momentum from 45:8 before the knowledge-and-mockery pattern is named.
topics.reason: The conjunction is the first word of the ayah and directly precedes the recurrent conditional frame.

topics.headline: quick audible hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the short connector and open temporal particle as a quick hinge into the lexical weight of the clause.
topics.reason: The sound observation does not alter the syntax but usefully describes the opening texture.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional adverb making completed knowing a recurrent trigger for the response clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed knowing in the condition answered by the taking-as-mockery response

words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) turns the completed-knowing half of {{ar:عَلِمَ ... ٱتَّخَذَهَا}} ({{tr:ʿalima ... ittakhadhahā}}) into a whenever-pattern rather than a single remote past. The particle frames completed awareness as the trigger, and the taking-as-mockery response supplies the immediate answer. That architecture makes mockery follow knowledge as its diagnostic response, not replace knowledge or excuse itself by ignorance.

topics.headline: completed knowing as repeated trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each completed arrival of knowledge becomes a repeatable test of response.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the conditional protasis and governs a perfect verb as a general condition.

topics.headline: exposure precedes mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah tests what happens after awareness arrives, not whether evidence ever reached the person.
topics.reason: The conditional protasis precedes and governs the apodosis, so exposure and response form one tight construction.

topics.headline: from sequence to type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior narrated profile (45:8) become a general recognizable pattern in 45:9.
topics.reason: The syntax compresses condition and response without an overt delay.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect: he knew, learned, or recognized; locally completed cognition before the derisive response
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, recognition, making known, teaching, marks, and signs; the local Form I selects settled awareness rather than causative teaching or inquiry

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the source-domain and object that give the knowing both origin and content

words.prose: {{ar:عَلِمَ}} ({{tr:ʿalima}}) places settled cognition before the mockery. The phrase {{ar:مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:min āyātinā shayʾan}}) gives that knowing both source and content, so the offense is not distance from evidence but misuse after awareness. It also makes signs and intelligibility collide with ridicule: what should clarify response becomes the occasion for contempt. Its Form I keeps the surface reading on the knower's own cognition; the passive teaching variant ʿullima sharpens the same accountability as contrast rather than replacing the canonical form. The word also continues the surah's knowledge thread, moving from hearing in 45:8 to knowing in 45:9 and later contested knowledge in 45:32.

topics.headline: knowledge has already landed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah condemns derision after determinate awareness, not ignorance or mere non-exposure.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form I perfect transitive verb, and V4 supports the knowing or recognizing sense for the root in this local class.

topics.headline: content and sign-source together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the known item is grammatically tied to the signs, so the later ridicule is aimed at the evidentiary source as well as the item.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the object and the prepositional source-domain as part of the same cognition frame.

topics.headline: plain knowing with teaching-variant contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the canonical focus on the knower's awareness while hearing how the teaching variant intensifies received-instruction irony.
topics.reason: The local surface is Form I, so variant and related form evidence can clarify contrast but cannot control the canonical parse.

topics.headline: hearing becomes knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 45:9 intensify 45:8 by moving from heard signs to known content, with later same-surah knowledge contrasts still in view (45:32).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, and the local lexical sequence supports the hearing-to-knowing escalation.

topics.headline: awareness collides with ridicule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shock: a word-family of intelligibility is made the occasion for ridicule rather than recognition.
topics.reason: The knowledge-sign connection is locally grammatical, and the response clause immediately collides it with mockery.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the signs as source, partitive field, or channel for the known item

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the sign-domain and minimized object linked by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) prevents the learned item in {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:āyātinā shayʾan}}) from floating free. It governs the sign phrase, so the small known item is drawn from, or mediated through, the signs. Because the prepositional phrase comes before the indefinite object, the ayah makes the divine sign-domain audible first and only then reduces the trigger to any item at all. The nasal sound of the preposition also clings to that sign phrase, matching the grammar's source-binding.

topics.headline: known item from the signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even a small known item remains grammatically attached to the divine sign-domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the preposition to govern the sign noun as the source or domain of the known item.

topics.headline: source named before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the evidence-domain before the minimized object, so the signs are foregrounded before the trigger is made small.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase intervenes between the verb and its accusative object.

topics.headline: sound binds source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the preposition cling to the sign phrase it governs.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation matches the syntactic dependency without changing the parse.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed signs, verses, proofs, or evidentiary markers governed by the source preposition and later resumed by the object pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: sign, verse, proof, mark, wonder, with a contested relation to return or refuge; locally the plural possessed sign-field is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later verb whose feminine pronoun resumes the sign-set

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) names a plural field of signs, verses, and proofs already marked as belonging to the divine speaker. It is genitive after the source preposition, so the known item comes from the sign-domain rather than from neutral data. The later verb {{ar:ٱتَّخَذَهَا}} ({{tr:ittakhadhahā}}) reaches back to this plural through its suffix, widening the offense: the person learns one thing from the signs, then reclassifies the sign-set as mockery. The disputed root pressure can keep mark and refuge associations in view, but local grammar selects the possessed plural signs as the governing field, with formulaic echoes at 2:231, 45:35, and the prior recited signs in 45:8.

topics.headline: Our signs, not neutral data
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence mocked is already marked as belonging to the divine speaker.
topics.reason: QAC marks the plural noun with first-person possessive suffix, and contextual evidence shows the sign noun commonly belongs to the divine referent.

topics.headline: from source-domain to object of mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the signs first as the source of knowledge and then as the object reclassified by the later pronoun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun genitive after the preposition and identifies the later object suffix as resuming it.

topics.headline: sign, verse, proof field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the breadth of signs, verses, proofs, and marks in view while the local plural grammar prevents reducing the offense to one harmless item.
topics.reason: The disputed derivation carries useful semantic pressure, but the local form and syntax select the plural sign-field.

topics.headline: signs-as-mockery pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the abuse pattern in which divine signs are taken as mockery, with concrete parallels at 2:231 and 45:35.
topics.reason: The intertextual rows supply concrete references and match the local signs-plus-mockery construction.

topics.headline: local sign-thread continues
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 45:9 continue the same-surah sign discourse from recitation in 45:8 into mockery after knowledge.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows give a concrete local recurrence of signs around this ayah.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object: a thing, anything, or some item known from the signs
words.root_gloss_range: thingness, knowable object, specification, and related will or volition branches; locally the broad object noun is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the verb, sign-source, and later pronoun arc surrounding the small object

words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) is the accusative object inside {{ar:عَلِمَ ... ءَايَٰتِنَا ... ٱتَّخَذَهَا}} ({{tr:ʿalima ... āyātinā ... ittakhadhahā}}), but its indefinite singular form makes the learned trigger minimal and open: any item from the signs is enough to expose the response. The source-field is heard before the small object, and the later pronoun then expands the effect from one known thing to the plural signs. The hamza-bearing form makes that tiny object audibly discrete rather than blurred. Wider branches of the root include will, specification, and other lexical byways, but the local noun selects broad thingness rather than those branches.

topics.headline: any learned item suffices
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the trigger is minimized without becoming trivial: any known item from the signs exposes the posture.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the indefinite accusative noun as the direct object of knowing.

topics.headline: one item opens the whole sign-set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the escalation from one known item to the plural signs reclassified as mockery.
topics.reason: The object is singular while the later object suffix resumes the plural signs.

topics.headline: broad object noun, not all root branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the word's broad any-thing force while local grammar excludes unrelated will or lexical byway branches as active senses.
topics.reason: V4 lists multiple root branches, but the local noun and object role select the general thing sense.

topics.headline: object lands after source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the divine sign-source first and the minimized object only afterward.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the direct object in the local sequence.

topics.headline: thingness echoes around the passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that this small object participates in a wider nearby thingness field, including 45:10 and 45:19, while remaining locally tied to the signs.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references and a broader categorical contrast.

topics.reason: The form and sound rows describe the hamza-bearing surface without changing the local noun sense.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII perfect with object suffix: he took, adopted, or made them into a role; locally the signs are made mockery
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, receiving, adopting, choosing, and making something into a role; the local Form VIII double-object frame selects deliberate reclassification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the resumed signs and result complement in the taking-as-mockery construction

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّخَذَهَا}} ({{tr:ittakhadhahā}}) is the response verb of the conditional clause. In {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَا ... هُزُوًا}} ({{tr:āyātinā ... huzuwan}}), the attached suffix resumes the signs and the following complement supplies the result role: he makes the signs mockery. Because the suffix is fused into the verb, taking and object arrive as one compressed action before the complement names the corrupt role. The Form VIII shape makes the action more deliberate than a bare mocking verb; it is adoption, appropriation, and reclassification after knowledge. The same construction reappears at 45:35 and is paralleled by 18:106, so 45:9 is a precise local instance of a wider signs-as-mockery abuse pattern.

topics.headline: signs made into mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb does not merely report laughter; it grammatically makes the signs into a mockery-role.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as first object and the following verbal noun as the second object or complement.

topics.headline: knowledge answered by taking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees derisive reclassification as the immediate answer to the knowledge condition.
topics.reason: The verb heads the conditional apodosis linked to the prior protasis.

topics.headline: deliberate adoption, not simple ridicule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the moral charge of deliberately adopting the signs into a corrupt role.
topics.reason: The local Form VIII verb is compatible with adoption and taking-for, and the double-object frame makes the result role explicit.

topics.headline: taking-as-mockery formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurring formula in which signs are taken as mockery, with concrete echoes at 18:106 and 45:35.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallel references and the local syntax matches the formula.

topics.headline: verb and pronoun fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the taking and its object compressed into one action before the complement is named.
topics.reason: The attached suffix is part of the surface word and the sound row describes the compressed verbal texture.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun or object-complement: mockery, derision, contemptuous lowering; locally the role assigned to the signs
words.root_gloss_range: mocking, deriding, treating lightly, and contemptuous lowering; local use selects derision as a result complement, not harmless amusement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the taking construction and final humiliation answer to the derision

words.prose: {{ar:هُزُوًا}} ({{tr:huzuwan}}) completes the taking construction as the role assigned to the signs: they are made mockery. Its verbal-noun form turns derision into an assigned status, and its indefiniteness leaves the contemptuous role open rather than naming a bounded joke. The root selects contemptuous lowering, not harmless humor, which is why {{ar:ٱتَّخَذَهَا ... مُّهِينٌ}} ({{tr:ittakhadhahā ... muhīnun}}) frames the answer so sharply: the lowering attempted against the signs returns as humiliation of the mocker. Hamzated and lightened variant recitation textures preserve the meaning while making the contempt word alternately more caught or compressed, and the taking-as-mockery formula is echoed at 31:6 and later in 45:35.

topics.headline: mockery as assigned role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mockery is not a side reaction; it is the predicate role into which the signs are placed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as the second object or object-complement of the taking verb.

topics.headline: derision as lowering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears contemptuous lowering rather than harmless play, preparing the final humiliation reversal.
topics.reason: The local verdict frame and final adjective fit contemptuous derision, not benign humor.

topics.headline: open derision status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the response clause seal by assigning an open derisive status to the signs.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a gerund or verbal noun in accusative complement position.

topics.headline: variant texture, same derision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the hamzated and lightened variant textures without letting them change the local sense of derision.
topics.reason: The variant rows concern recitation surface and preserve the same mockery value rather than replacing the canonical parse.

topics.headline: mockery formula answered by humiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the taking-as-mockery formula (31:6) and sees it locally answered by the humiliation verdict.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula references and the local final adjective supplies the reversal.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural demonstrative that resumes the described offender type and pivots into the verdict clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fronted liability phrase and delayed punishment subject introduced after the demonstrative

words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) pivots from the offense to the verdict. The conditional scene used a singular offender, but this plural demonstrative turns that profile into a judged class: those who fit the pattern. Its distal pointing adds evaluative distance before {{ar:لَ هُمْ عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:la hum ʿadhābun}}) assigns the consequence, so identification and recompense are tightly linked.

topics.headline: singular offender becomes class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a singular behavior-profile is generalized into a plural liable class.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a masculine plural demonstrative, and cross-reference evidence says it resumes the described offender type.

topics.headline: pointing with distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the demonstrative point at the group from evaluative distance, not as a neutral pronoun.
topics.reason: The demonstrative form functions as the subject of the consequence clause and marks the group deictically.

topics.headline: pivot into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause turn from describing mockery to assigning punishment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the span beginning with the demonstrative as a nominal consequence clause.

words.gloss_range: prefixed prepositional lām of allocation, possession, or deserved liability, split from the following pronoun in the bundle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the pronoun governed by the lām and the delayed punishment noun

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) begins the fronted phrase that assigns the verdict before the punishment noun appears. Its values of possession, allocation, and deserved liability converge here: the punishment is theirs because it is assigned to them and due against them. The split bundle's lām plus pronoun forms a compact fronted unit, so class reference and allocation arrive together. Fused with the pronoun in {{ar:هُمْ عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:hum ʿadhābun}}), the particle binds the demonstrative class to the consequence with no gap between identification and recompense.

topics.headline: assigned and deserved consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lām marks the punishment as assigned to the class and due against it.
topics.reason: The particle governs the pronoun in the fronted prepositional predicate before the delayed punishment subject.

topics.headline: liability before punishment noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears liability fixed before the punishment is named.
topics.reason: The prepositional predicate precedes the nominative punishment noun in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: compact liability unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees class reference and allocation compressed into the single verdict unit.
topics.reason: The bundle splits the particle and pronoun, but together they form the fronted prepositional phrase.

words.gloss_range: third-person masculine plural pronoun governed by the lām, resuming the demonstrative class inside the fronted predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the demonstrative class, allocation particle, and delayed punishment subject around the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) carries the plural class in {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَ ... عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika la- ... ʿadhābun}}) into the fronted predicate. Bound to the lām, it compresses group reference and liability into one phrase, and because that phrase precedes the punishment noun, the offenders' liability is heard before the punishment is named. The singular profile from 45:8 is not abandoned; it is expanded into a liable group.

topics.headline: class carried into predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict clause keeps the same behavior-defined group continuously in view.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence identifies the pronoun as resuming the demonstrative class.

topics.headline: bound pronoun compresses liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears group reference and assigned liability before the punishment noun arrives.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the fronted lām phrase, which precedes the delayed subject.

topics.headline: profile expands into group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the singular offender portrait from 45:8 and the condition become collective liability in 45:9.
topics.reason: The plural pronoun sits inside the consequence clause while resuming the plural demonstrative class.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative punishment noun, delayed after the fronted liability phrase and qualified by humiliation
words.root_gloss_range: punishment, torment, severity, sweetness or fresh water, abstaining, and other branches; locally the verdict frame selects punitive recompense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fronted liability phrase and the adjective that defines the punishment's humiliating effect

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) is the delayed nominative subject after the fronted liability phrase in {{ar:لَهُمْ ... مُّهِينٌ}} ({{tr:lahum ... muhīnun}}): liability is assigned first, then the punishment is named. Its indefiniteness leaves the penalty open in magnitude and kind until the final adjective specifies humiliation as its defining effect. As a noun rather than a finite verb, it presents punishment as an assigned state, and the paired -un cadence binds that state to its humiliating qualifier. The root has distant sweetness and freshness branches, but the local verdict frame and adjective force punitive recompense; that absent sweetness becomes a reversal pressure rather than the active sense. The noun also keeps the local punishment thread moving from 45:8 through 45:10 and matches the humiliation formula seen at 31:6.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears liability fixed before the punishment noun appears.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the prepositional phrase before the delayed nominative subject.

topics.reason: The local punishment clause and humiliating adjective select the punitive branch and block the sweetness branch as an active sense.

topics.headline: punishment paired with humiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a stable humiliating-punishment formula, concretely matched at 31:6, now attached to mockery after knowledge.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and formula rows supply the pair and concrete cross-reference.

topics.headline: consequence thread through nearby ayahs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees punishment recur across 45:8, 45:9, and 45:10 while the qualifier shifts to fit each offense.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah recurrence around the local section.

topics.headline: noun-state and paired cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears punishment presented as an assigned state and bound acoustically to its humiliating qualifier.
topics.reason: The noun form and paired indefinite cadence support the closure effect without changing the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative active participle qualifying the punishment: humiliating, causing abasement, status-lowering
words.root_gloss_range: lowness, abasement, contemptibility, service or ordinary use, weakening, and related branches; locally the Form IV active participle selects causative humiliation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the mockery that the final humiliation answers and the punishment noun it qualifies

words.prose: {{ar:مُّهِينٌۭ}} ({{tr:muhīnun}}) closes the ayah by defining the punishment as one that humiliates. As an indefinite active participle in {{ar:هُزُوًا ... عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:huzuwan ... ʿadhābun}}), it makes abasement an active effect of the punishment, not a separate label on the people. The root field centers lowering and contempt, while the local Form IV participle gives causative force: the consequence lowers the mocker. As the last word, it seals the verdict on the exact reversal, and the paired -un cadence makes punishment and humiliating effect sound like one closed phrase. That final word reverses the mockery: attempted degradation of the signs returns as status-collapse, within a recurring humiliating-punishment formula also seen at 2:90, 31:6, and 58:16.

topics.headline: punishment that humiliates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humiliation is an active effect generated by the punishment itself.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an active participle/adjective qualifying the punishment, and attachment evidence confirms the adjective relation.

topics.headline: adjective locked to punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees humiliation locked onto the punishment as its defining qualitative feature.
topics.reason: The noun and adjective agree as indefinite nominatives, so the adjective qualifies the punishment rather than describing the people separately.

topics.headline: mockery's lowering returned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the lexical reversal: the signs were lowered in mockery, and the mocker is lowered by punishment.
topics.reason: The mockery noun and final humiliating adjective form a local semantic reversal.

topics.headline: causative abasement branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the root's status-lowering field while the local participle selects causative humiliation over unrelated service or ordinary-use branches.
topics.reason: V4 lists several branches, but the local active participle attached to punishment selects causative abasement.

topics.headline: recurring humiliation verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the humiliating-punishment formula in rejection contexts, including 2:90, 31:6, and 58:16, now specified by mockery after knowledge.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows place the participle mainly beside punishment formulas and give concrete cross-passage references.

topics.headline: last-word verdict seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on the exact effect that reverses the offense.
topics.reason: The word is the final term of the ayah and completes the paired indefinite punishment phrase.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional joins actual knowing of one item from a plural sign-field to taking the plural signs as ridicule.
baseline_models.mechanism: A knowable item is disclosed and selected from many manifest signs; the subject then deliberately acquires a new use for the whole plurality. The singular-to-plural movement lets a fragment become the lever for a total dismissive classification.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower establishes real cognition, making the later mockery a conversion of knowledge rather than simple ignorance.
A conspicuous marker supplies the plural field whose evidentiary function is being reassigned.
The most general knowable and reportable item makes even a minimal piece sufficient to trigger the response.
Deliberate adoption or acquisition turns ridicule into a chosen standing use, not an involuntary reaction.
Ridicule supplies the destination category into which the known signs are placed.

changed_reading.before: An ignorant person happens to joke about a sign.
changed_reading.after: Once even one item becomes known, the subject uses it to recode the whole sign-field as ridicule; the fault is epistemic appropriation and overgeneralized dismissal, not lack of exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The knowing root also carries an identifying-mark branch, while the signs root carries a visible-marker branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two marker-images overlap: a mark makes something recognizable and a sign makes something else evident. Taking those signs as ridicule does not erase their visibility; it diverts their pointing function into a social performance that points back to the mocker.

activation_trace.role: An identifying trace that guides toward its referent frames knowledge as successful recognition of a marker.
The visible-sign image supplies the intended outward reference that mockery redirects.
Seizing and bringing something into one's control supplies the act that captures the signs' public function.
Social derision becomes the counterfeit destination of the signs' pointing power.

changed_reading.before: The subject rejects the informational content of signs.
changed_reading.after: The subject recognizes the signs as marks yet sabotages what they are for, converting outward reference into a performance of self-positioning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The offense is ridicule and the consequence is specified as a humiliating punishment rather than punishment without a named modality.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ridicule lowers its object in a social hierarchy. The consequence combines pain with contemptuous abasement, low status, and weakened capacity, so its distinctive adjective mirrors the operation of the offense instead of merely increasing severity.

activation_trace.role: Derision supplies the offender's attempted lowering of the signs.
Severe penal pain supplies the consequence's punitive substrate.
The alternate resolution into lowness and weakness adds social devaluation to bodily pain.
Contemptuous abasement directly reverses the contempt projected through mockery.
The non-dominant weakening branch extends humiliation from reputation to loss of effective strength and resolve.

changed_reading.before: A generic punishment follows a generic act of mockery.
changed_reading.after: The punishment is calibrated to the offense: one who tries to lower the signs undergoes painful lowering, contempt, and loss of standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The subject takes the signs for a chosen purpose, while the closing possession construction assigns a humiliating punishment to the resulting class.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse opens an economy of acquisition and closes one of accrual. What the subject elects to make his own is a use of the signs; what becomes assigned to him is the consequence, so agency returns as unwanted possession.

activation_trace.role: Chosen acquisition supplies the voluntary side of the verse's possession pattern.
Penal suffering supplies what ultimately accrues to the subject.
Abasement gives the accrued consequence the same status-domain in which ridicule operated.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists an offense and then announces an unrelated sentence.
changed_reading.after: The syntax reverses acquisition: the subject chooses a degrading use for the signs, and a degrading consequence becomes his own assigned outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence distributes signs across cosmos, creatures, temporal cycles, revivifying provision, and recitation, while rotating appropriate receptions through trust, certainty, and reason. Against that abundance, knowing one thing is a sample from an already redundant field, so using it to dismiss the plurality is radically disproportionate.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker in the cosmic pair begins the distributed evidentiary field.
Heart-settling assent supplies one successful mode of receiving the markers.
Knowledge stabilized beyond doubt supplies a second successful reception mode.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies a third way the sign-sequence should govern response.
Ordered following turns the same sign-field into sequentially transmitted discourse.
A single knowable item now reads as a deliberately tiny sample set against the contextual abundance.

structural_cues: 45:3-5 repeat the signs construction after distinct natural and creaturely sequences.
45:3-5 rotate recipient responses from believing to certainty to reasoning.
45:6 carries the same signs into recited address before 45:9 reduces them through one known item.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated modalities and response classes; I infer that the indefinite item in 45:9 is intentionally disproportionate to that field. It may alternatively mean any item without a specifically minimal force, but the partial-to-plural jump remains.

changed_reading.before: The subject mocks one isolated piece of evidence.
changed_reading.after: The subject extracts one sample from a redundant, multimodal sign-system and uses that fragment to dismiss the entire system despite several available modes of responsible reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene separates audible receipt from responsive hearing: recitation reaches the subject, persistence and self-magnification intervene, and he behaves as though he never heard. The focus verse advances from hearing to knowing and from simulated nonreceipt to active genre-conversion as ridicule.

activation_trace.role: Physical auditory reception occurs and is then rhetorically denied, preventing ignorance from explaining the response.
The understanding-and-compliance branch exposes the gap between sound entering and guidance governing conduct.
Sequential transmission makes the encounter sustained rather than a stray overheard fragment.
Fixed resolve supplies the active resistance between reception and response.
Claimed greatness supplies the status motive for refusing responsive hearing.
Explicit cognition marks the next stage beyond mere auditory exposure.
Ridicule becomes an active device for neutralizing what can no longer plausibly be unheard.

structural_cues: 45:8 uses a then-sequence from recitation to persistence and a comparison to one who did not hear.
45:9 follows with a when-condition based on knowing, increasing rather than reducing epistemic contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent reception stages; I infer an escalation from feigned nonhearing to mocking neutralization. The two verses could instead portray neighboring offender types, but both still define post-reception resistance.

changed_reading.before: Mockery is an immediate emotional reaction to unfamiliar material.
changed_reading.after: Mockery is a later-stage neutralization strategy after sound has arrived, responsive hearing has been refused, and some content has become known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated taking-constructions select protectors, desire as deity, and signs as ridicule. The focus act therefore belongs to a larger architecture of chosen allegiance and classification: inward inclination becomes governing authority, false supports are acquired, and signs are assigned the role that protects this arrangement from challenge.

activation_trace.role: Adopting something for oneself frames false protectors as deliberate acquisitions.
Protective alliance supplies the relational function expected from what is adopted.
A second adoption construction makes worship itself an elected arrangement.
The inward pull of desire supplies the authority that can govern how known signs are classified.
The focus construction's exact return turns its chosen classification into the later charge.
The repeated derision category confirms that the adopted use persisted beyond a passing joke.
The focus adoption now functions as one link in the contextual chain of elected loyalties.

structural_cues: 45:10, 45:23, and 45:35 repeat the same transitive taking pattern with different adopted objects.
45:35 repeats the focus pairing of taking, signs, and ridicule as a retrospective charge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel constructions; I infer that they expose one value-system in which desire governs and mockery protects it. They may alternatively be independent examples of misuse linked rhetorically rather than causally.

changed_reading.before: Ridicule is a spontaneous joke about unwelcome evidence.
changed_reading.after: Ridicule is an adopted practice inside a system of allegiance: desire is enthroned, substitute supports are chosen, and signs are assigned a comic role that keeps that order intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea and the total created field are made serviceable for directed benefits, with gratitude and reflection as intended responses. The subjugation root's own ridicule branch creates a latent bridge: the mocker counterfeits legitimate serviceability by forcing the signs themselves to serve amusement and self-protection rather than their orienting purpose.

activation_trace.role: Directed subjugation of the sea supplies the proper pattern of something made available for a stated end.
The same inventory's derision branch forms the latent bridge from divinely ordered service to the mocker's counterfeit use.
Making the whole cosmic field serve human benefit expands the use-relation beyond the sea.
Recognition of gift and giver supplies one proper endpoint of things made serviceable.
Sustained mental movement around the given field supplies the alternative to instant comic capture.
Ridicule names the improper purpose imposed on the signs.
Debasement through being used lets the consequence reverse the mocker's reduction of signs to usable material.

structural_cues: 45:12 attaches subjugation to purpose clauses of movement, seeking bounty, and gratitude.
45:13 attaches cosmic subjugation to the presence of signs for people who reflect.
45:9 likewise gives a chosen purpose-category to the signs, but that purpose is ridicule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the subjection/ridicule branch pairing and contrasting purpose clauses; I infer a counterfeit use-relation. The live alternative is a moral contrast without a deliberate root-level analogy.

changed_reading.before: The mocker merely says something disrespectful about signs.
changed_reading.after: The mocker performs counterfeit subjugation, forcing signs that should orient gratitude and reflection to serve ego and amusement; degrading punishment reverses the user-used hierarchy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Believers are instructed to cover or forgive the offense while recompense answers what people earn. This separates the human response from the announced humiliating punishment: the verse diagnoses a consequence but does not authorize believers to reproduce the mocker's status-violence socially.

activation_trace.role: Covering an offense and shielding its bearer from immediate effect supplies the commanded human posture.
Measured return for action assigns recompense to a distinct accounting process.
Acquired benefit or deed makes the people accountable for what their conduct brings in.
The social injury of derision is the offense believers might otherwise be tempted to mirror.
Punitive pain remains the announced horizon while its administration is kept apart from private retaliation.

structural_cues: 45:14 directs believers to forgive those who do not expect the days of God.
The purpose clause in 45:14 shifts from that imperative to recompense according to what a people earned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separate agents and actions; I infer that the focus sentence is not a license for social counter-humiliation. Forgiveness may alternatively denote temporary forbearance rather than a general jurisdictional boundary.

changed_reading.before: Naming humiliating punishment invites the offended community to humiliate the mocker in return.
changed_reading.after: The consequence belongs to divine accounting, while the immediate human posture is forgiveness; mimicking the offense would collapse the contextual separation of roles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context links intended action to the self, earned action to exact recompense, and deeds to a copied record that speaks. This expands the focus possession reversal: the punishment is assigned to them because their chosen use of signs has become an authored, preserved, and publicly articulable consequence.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action begins the causal chain from conduct to outcome.
The very self as beneficiary or bearer keeps the consequence attached to its author.
Action answered by its corresponding return supplies measure rather than arbitrary infliction.
Acquisition language makes conduct something whose yield accrues to the actor.
The withholding-of-right image marks the accounting as free of deprivation or misallocation.
An ordered written record gives durable form to otherwise deniable conduct.
A sign that itself testifies restores evidentiary speech after signs were converted into jokes.
Copying a record supplies preservation of each performed act for later articulation.
Voluntary adoption in the focus verse supplies the authored choice recorded by the contextual mechanism.
Punishment is the painful yield to which the action-record chain leads.

structural_cues: 45:15 contrasts action for the self with wrongdoing upon it.
45:22 joins every self, what it earned, exact recompense, and absence of wrong.
45:28-29 move from being called to a book to a book that speaks and a record copied from deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the action-compensation-record sequence; I infer that the focus assignment construction presents punishment as an accrued authored outcome. The alternative is ordinary external bookkeeping without a stronger self-authorship claim.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an externally imposed response that merely follows the joke.
changed_reading.after: The chosen degradation of signs produces an accountable yield: it adheres to the actor, is preserved as deed, and later becomes evidence capable of speaking publicly.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge arrives before rivalrous transgression; the commanded path is opposed to the desires of nonknowers; desire can be adopted as deity alongside knowledge; sealing then blocks reception; and unsupported claims fall back to conjecture. Knowledge is therefore not self-executing: a governing appetite can conscript it, with mockery as one way to keep known signs subordinate.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure precedes the ensuing division, proving that knowledge can coexist with resistant conduct.
Competitive transgression supplies a social motive that redirects what knowledge should settle.
The pull of appetite supplies a rival path capable of governing conduct.
The nonknowing group marks desire-following as an epistemic failure, not merely a different taste.
The knowledge phrase keeps cognition live at the point where desire has been enthroned, while leaving its grammatical agent open.
Subjective inclination supplies the governing authority that can bend cognition toward self-protection.
A secured closure supplies the hardened endpoint of repeatedly refusing what was received.
The explicit absence of disclosed knowledge contrasts with the focus subject who does know something.
Unstable supposition supplies the epistemic residue after signs have been denied governing force.
Ridicule functions as the technique by which desire keeps disclosed material from becoming authoritative.

structural_cues: 45:17 places knowledge before division and names rivalry between the recipients.
45:18 opposes following a commanded path to following the desires of those who do not know.
45:23 juxtaposes adopted desire, knowledge, and sealed faculties.
45:24 contrasts lack of knowledge with conjecture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies these juxtapositions; I infer that appetite and rivalry govern the use of known material. In 45:23, the knowledge phrase may instead describe God's knowing act of misguidance, so that verse sharpens but does not solely establish the model.

changed_reading.before: Once a sign is known, assent should follow automatically, so mockery is puzzling inconsistency.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge can be captured by rivalry and desire; mockery is motivated cognition that strips known signs of authority while preserving a preferred allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: When clear signs are recited, the respondents' sole argument is a demand for an impossible demonstration and a challenge to the speakers' truthfulness. This gives ridicule an argumentative mechanism: evidence is not answered but converted into spectacle, while the burden is shifted to the revealer.

activation_trace.role: Ordered recitation supplies the evidence encounter to which the response is made.
Meaning disclosed through speech or marker establishes that obscurity is not the stated problem.
A case meant to prevail supplies the formal guise adopted by the dismissive demand.
Truthful speech becomes the target of a challenge whose criterion the respondents themselves set.
Ridicule can now be realized as a taunting evidentiary maneuver rather than audible laughter.

structural_cues: 45:25 restricts their argument to one quoted demand.
The demand replaces engagement with the recited clear signs by requiring absent ancestors to be produced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a clear-sign scene followed by a sole counter-demand; I infer burden-shifting and spectacle as the mechanism of mockery. The demand could alternatively be a sincere but invalid evidentiary criterion rather than a conscious taunt.

changed_reading.before: Taking signs as ridicule means only joking or laughing at their wording.
changed_reading.after: Ridicule can take procedural form: clear evidence is recoded as an occasion for an impossible counter-demand that performs argument while preventing evaluation.

context_deltas.mechanism: What their actions produced becomes visible, and what they mocked comes down around them. The exact focus construction then returns as a charge, worldly glitter is named as deception, and exit is denied. Agency and scale reverse: the subject who captured a small item and made the signs a joke is publicly exposed and enclosed by the reality he tried to contain.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into visibility converts hidden or deniable consequences into public exposure.
Harm descending and surrounding supplies the spatial reversal from seizing an object to being enclosed.
The object of derision returns as the very reality participating in the enclosure.
The repeated adoption construction makes the earlier chosen use formally answerable at judgment.
Repeated derision identifies the focus behavior as the enduring charge rather than an incidental detail.
Attractive but unstable deception supplies the screen that made the reductive classification feel secure.
Passage to an outside is explicitly blocked, completing the enclosure mechanism.
Abasement now reads as exposed loss of status inside the reality the subject had dismissed.

structural_cues: 45:33 reverses grammatical agency: bad acts appear and the mocked object surrounds the mockers.
45:35 repeats the focus offense, adds deception by worldly life, and closes both exit and appeasement.
The focus moves from one known item to plural signs; the ending moves from treating reality as an object to reality becoming an environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appearance, surrounding harm, exact reprise, and no exit; I infer a capture-to-enclosure reversal. The relative expression in 45:33 may refer more narrowly to judgment or punishment they mocked rather than to every sign.

changed_reading.before: Humiliating punishment is an externally delivered insult after mockery.
changed_reading.after: Humiliation is the public and inescapable reversal of scale and agency: the mocked reality appears, surrounds, and traps the one who had reduced it to comic material.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-magnification accompanies the first reception scene, returns in the judgmental reprise, and is finally answered by the assignment of grandeur to God. Mockery is therefore a vertical status act: the subject raises himself by lowering signs, while humiliating punishment corrects that false arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Claimed greatness supplies the elevated self-position from which the signs are dismissed.
The return of self-magnification in the retrospective charge shows that status posture persisted.
The closing ownership of grandeur relocates legitimate height away from the mocker's self-claim.
Derision performs the lowering half of the mocker's vertical status claim.
Contemptuous abasement reverses the false elevation generated through mockery.

structural_cues: 45:8 and 45:31 pair reception of signs with the same self-magnifying posture.
45:37 closes the surah by assigning grandeur rather than leaving it as the offender's implied possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and closing possession; I infer a vertical status contest linking arrogance, mockery, and humiliation. Arrogance may alternatively be one accompanying trait rather than the direct engine of every mockery act.

changed_reading.before: Humiliation merely adds emotional pain to the sentence.
changed_reading.after: Humiliation repairs a vertical falsification: self-magnification had lowered the signs, and the consequence exposes that claimed height while the closing grandeur belongs elsewhere.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates remote water-images within two focus roots; it remains anchored in those supplied branches and is awakened by the sea-and-vessel context of 45:12. Render it only as a spatial analogy for selective knowing, never as the lexical translation of either focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines knowing one item with taking the signs, while remote branches image abundant gathered water and a bounded place that holds water.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water spatializes the sign-field as abundance surrounding one act of knowing.
A bounded water-holding place supplies the image of impounding a manageable portion from a larger field.
One knowable item gives the bounded sample its explicit focus-verse anchor.
Expansive abundant water activates the remote aquatic scale of the focus knowing root.
A bounded vessel moving within water supplies the relation between a finite carrier and a much larger medium.

changed_reading.before: The subject knows an isolated fact and mocks it.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory spatial model, the subject captures a vessel-sized sample from an oceanic sign-field, mistakes control of the sample for mastery of the whole, and converts the impounded fragment into mockery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus noun's listening branch is rare and should not replace its ordinary sense; it remains valid as activation because the branch is supplied and 45:8 immediately foregrounds hearing and serial recitation. Downstream prose should call it an auditory resonance, not translate the noun as listening.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The indefinite item in the focus has a supplied branch of attentive listening, immediately after a scene of hearing recited signs.

activation_trace.role: Attentive listening latent within the item-root lets the known 'something' resonate as a captured audible fragment.
Actual sound perception supplies the immediate contextual activation for that remote branch.
One sound following another gives the received fragment an ordered acoustic texture.
Cognition anchors the auditory resonance in actual uptake rather than mere sound contact.

changed_reading.before: The known item is an abstract proposition detached from the hearing scene.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the item is the small audible uptake that survives serial recitation and becomes known before being captured as comic material.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines remote restraint, service, debasement-through-use, and weakening branches; all are anchored in the focus punishment phrase and activated by contextual subjugation. Render it as a relational reversal only, not as a replacement gloss for punishment or humiliation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from elective use of signs to a punishment whose split-root branches include restraint, service, debasement by use, and weakness.

activation_trace.role: Elective appropriation supplies the offender's initial position as user and classifier.
Restraint and forced abstention supply an exploratory decommissioning of the self-serving use.
Service and skilled labor invert the offender's assumed position from autonomous user toward one placed in service.
Debasement through repeated use makes the inversion specifically answer the reduction of signs to instruments.
Loss of strength and resolve removes the effective autonomy claimed by the user of signs.
Compelled service without return intensifies the contextual use-hierarchy that the outlier reverses.

changed_reading.before: The consequence simply makes the mocker feel ashamed.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory relational model, punishment decommissions the act of instrumentalizing signs and reverses the hierarchy: the autonomous user becomes restrained, weakened, and subject to the degradation of being used.

strongest_changes: The focus is not an ignorance scene but a post-reception conversion in which one known sample is used to dismiss a plural, redundant sign-field.
Repeated taking-constructions connect ridicule to a larger allegiance system governed by desire and false supports.
The subjugation root's ridicule branch exposes mockery as counterfeit use of signs that should orient gratitude and reflection.
The ending turns seizure into enclosure: the mocked reality appears, surrounds the mocker, and makes the distinctive humiliation a measure-for-measure reversal.
Contextual forgiveness and exact accounting keep the announced humiliation distinct from human retaliatory shaming.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activation was relational rather than topical: visible signs are captured and reassigned, repeated adoption reveals the governing loyalty, proper subjugation is counterfeited as comic use, and the final context reverses object and environment. Split resolutions of the humiliation root preserved additional live readings of low status, debasement through use, and weakened agency without collapsing them into one gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The singular known item may be minimally contrastive, merely indefinite, or a representative part; each keeps the plural-pronoun expansion live at a different strength.
The knowledge phrase in 45:23 may describe the person's epistemic state or God's knowing act, so it cannot alone prove desire's capture of knowledge.
The repeated taking-constructions may encode one causal allegiance system or may function as a looser rhetorical series of misclassifications.
The aquatic and service-based outliers are packet-licensed analogies but remain too branch-distant for unqualified lexical rendering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Contempt returned as abasement.** `ه ز ء/B001` is derision, and `ه و ن/B003` is humiliation through contempt. The pronoun shift from learning "a thing" to taking "them" as ridicule enlarges a fragmentary encounter into wholesale dismissal. The packet later makes mocked matters surround the mockers (45:33) and identifies this ridicule as a cause of exclusion (45:35). I infer a reciprocal arrow: treating signs as insignificant forms the mode of the answering punishment. `مهين` is thus not arbitrary severity but the social relation of contempt reversed upon its author.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: In 45:33 the object of ridicule becomes the surrounding subject, and 45:35 names ridicule again at the point when exit and appeasement are refused.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mockery begins by extracting a knowable fragment from its system.** Lexical anchors: knowing in `ع ل م B001`, the "knowable thing" variant of `ش ي ء B001`, and making something for oneself in `ء خ ذ B010`. The packet supplies integrated creation/revival/recitation in 45:4-6 and purposeful cosmic service in 45:12-13. I infer system -> detached fragment -> appropriated prop. Learning `شَيْـًٔا` is thus not innocent incompleteness: the following `ٱتَّخَذَهَا` converts a severed piece of evidence into material for ridicule.
2. **Contempt returns as abasement.** Lexical anchors: mockery in `ه ز ء B001`, humiliation through contempt in `ه و ن B003`, and punishment in `ع ذ ب B005`. The packet supplies the same mockery-to-consequence sequence across 45:8-11 and explicitly introduces matching recompense in 45:14 (`ج ز ي B001`). I supply the directional arrow contempt projected outward -> contempt-shaped humiliation returned. The punishment now reads as a structural reversal of the agent's own social gesture, not an unrelated penalty appended to it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:12-13 made the detached-fragment reading visible by contrasting `شَيْـًٔا` with integrated systems ordered for a purpose. 45:14's matching recompense then clarified humiliation as contempt returning in the form the agent had projected.

baseline.text: Ayetlerimizden bir şey öğrendiğinde onları alaya alır. İşte onlar için aşağılayıcı bir azap vardır.

findings.text: Alay, bilinen küçük bir parçayı ait olduğu işaretler sisteminden koparıp kişinin kendi gösteri aracına dönüştürmesiyle başlar.
İşaretlere yöneltilen küçümseme, aynı toplumsal ilişkinin failine aşağılanma olarak dönmesiyle cezanın biçimini belirler.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A message moves through ordered marks and voices into a receiver, where it is either understood, physically blocked, or impressed on the body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Recitation behaves like a following chain, refusal like a tightened knot and covering, and proclamation like news that alters the skin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing Is Tied Off Into Refusal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sound reaches the ear, but comprehension is arrested by a binding resolve, self-elevation, covering, diversion, and mockery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); understanding that issues in obedience (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); binding and knotting (`quranic:root_000856:B001/m01`); fixed resolve and persistence (`quranic:root_000856:B002/m01`); human self-exaltation (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`); covering that hides (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); turning a thing from its proper direction (`quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`); ridicule (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The failure occurs after acoustic contact. A knot converts persistence into blockage; pride supplies the posture, covering suppresses disclosure, and diversion turns the received sign away from its intended course.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A message moves through ordered marks and voices into a receiver, where it is either understood, physically blocked, or impressed on the body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Recitation behaves like a following chain, refusal like a tightened knot and covering, and proclamation like news that alters the skin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Proclamation Reaches the Skin
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An announced outcome passes from speech to bodily surface and is completed as felt and inflicted pain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exposed skin or surface (`quranic:root_000120:B001/m01`); news that opens or changes the skin (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`); felt pain (`quranic:root_000046:B001/m01`); causing pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`); punitive suffering (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The ironic proclamation of punishment is not only verbal. The branch imagery lets news register on the body's outer surface and then pass inward as sensation, giving the announcement a concrete terminal medium.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Height, force, and magnitude establish rank, but self-assigned elevation is inverted into abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic above-and-below relations become the scale by which human inflation is exposed and reversed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inflated Height Ends in Humiliation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person enlarges his own rank, while punishment reassigns magnitude to the consequence and lowers the claimant into humiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: human self-exaltation (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`); greatness and magnitude (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); abasement by contempt (`quranic:root_001608:B003/m01`); punitive suffering (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The offender's attempted enlargement is not merely condemned; its scale is transferred. The consequence becomes `عَظِيم`, while the self-elevated subject receives `مُّهِين`, producing a precise role reversal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi bilme ve gerçeğiyle kavramadır; bildirme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında yenme ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği işaretleme eylemine daha sıkı bağlıdır; odak dal ise konmuş işaretlerin yanında doğal kılavuzları ve bayrağı da adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal işaret koyma dışında bayrak, dağ, yol kılavuzu ve kumaş deseni gibi bağımsız adları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, hayvana veya nesneye yakma, kesme ya da benzeri yolla bırakılan bedensel ve maddi damgayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal görünür bir belirti aracılığıyla tanıtma ve ayırt etme işlevini paylaşır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح واحد يدل على أثر بالشيء يتميز به عن غيره (maqayis)؛ العلامة وهي معروفة (maqayis)؛ العلم الراية والجمع أعلام (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلم الجبل الطويل والجميع الأعلام (ayn)؛ العلم الجبل (sihah;mufradat)؛ المعلم الأثر يستدل به على الطريق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ علم الثوب ورقمه في أطرافه (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أعلم الفارس إذا كانت له علامة في الحرب (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلام الحناء (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ علمت عمتي أعلمها علما (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların çoğu hayvan bedenindeki renk ve işaretleri ya da ilgisiz özel adları anlatır; aynı kökün bilme ve işaret dalları adlandırma gerekçesini açıklasa da bu dalın yaratılmışlar bütünü sınırını keskinleştirecek bir karşıtlık oluşturmaz.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العالم والعالمون بمعنى الخلق أو أصناف الخلائق أو كل جنس من الخلق لأنه معلم في نفسه ودال

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. Genel yarılma anlamı veya alt dudaktaki bir biçim bozukluğu bu dala dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti özellikle üst dudakta bulunur; genel çatlaklar, alt dudak ve ağız çevresindeki başka eğrilikler kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üst dudak yarığı dalın temelidir; yarıklı kişi veya deve nitelemesi ile üst dudağı yarma eylemi ilgili biçimlere bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Üst dudağı yarık insan veya üst dudak bölgesinde bu belirti bulunan deve, özelliği taşıyan varlık olarak nitelenir.
Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yarığın yerini üst dudak olarak ortak biçimde sınırlar ve yarıklı insanı bu özellikle niteler. Toplu tanıklık, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki karşılığını ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de aynı dalda gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki belirgin yarığı adlandıran temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yarığın türünü ve özellikle üst dudaktaki yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanı veya deveyi üst dudak bölgesindeki yarıkla niteleyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin üst dudağında yarık oluşturma eylemini anlatan kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi, etkilenen kişiyi ve üst dudak sınırını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üst dudağı yarık kişi veya deve

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesne, deri, toprak, dağ ve başka yüzeylerdeki genel yarılma ve açılma sürecini kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

concept_gloss.text: deniz ya da suyu bol kuyu

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Odak dalın deniz karşılığı, komşu dalın geniş ve çok su çekirdeğiyle örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnızca deniz karşılığındadır; odak dalın kuyu seçeneği komşuda bulunmaz, komşunun büyük ırmak ve genel su genişliği ise odak dalın tanımına girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyudaki kovadan dökülen veya havuza taşan suyu, kokusunu ve taşma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: suyu bol kuyu ile kuyu suyu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kuyu çevresinde suyun çokluğu ve görünür birikimiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suyu taşıyan kuyuyu niteler; komşu dal ise kuyudan dökülen suyu ve taşma sürecini merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Deniz karşılığını açıklayan geniş su dalı ile kuyu çevresindeki bol su dalı seçildi; diğer adaylar gölet, artık su, taşkın veya su tutan arazi gibi farklı taşıyıcı ve süreçlere bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden yırtıcı kuş için verir ve geçici dal görüntüsünü doğrular. Çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi ise kuş adından türetilmiş ayrı bir biçimdir; kuşun tanımına doğrudan katılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş adını tanımlar; insan nitelemesi türemiş bir sözcüksel uzantı olarak bağımlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğan veya atmaca türünden bir yırtıcı kuş adıdır. Bu kuş adından türetilen bir niteleme, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği anlatır.

facets.statement: Ad, doğan veya atmaca türünden avcı bir kuşu gösterir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adından türemiş insan nitelemesinin kullanıldığı bağlama özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan oluşu ile çeviklik ve zekâ niteliklerini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğan ve atmaca çevresindeki avcı kuş adlandırmaları alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle zeki ve keskin bakışlı doğanlara verilen bir adı belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal doğan türünden yırtıcı kuşları adlandırır ve zekâ çağrışımını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda zekâ kuştan türetilen insan niteliğinde belirginleşir; komşuda ise doğrudan belirli doğanların özelliğidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlami kokten gelen bekleme ve kalma cekirdegiyle sinirlar; baska edat veya ad kullanimlari buraya alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde veya bir isin basinda oyalanarak durmak, beklemek ya da kalinacak yer olarak tutulmak.

facets.statement: Kisi veya sey hareketi erteleyip durur, oyalanir ya da bekler.
Bir isin gerceklesme imkanini bekleme anlami da ayni durup bekleme cekirdegine baglidir.
Kalinan veya beklenilen yer icin konaklama ve tutulma yeri anlaminda adlasmis kullanim vardir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin temelini durma, oyalanma ve bekleme olarak verir; ayrica bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinacak yer kullanimi ayni anlam alaninda yer alir.

error_profile.loses: Kalinan yer olarak adlasmis kullanim tam olarak gorunmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini amaclayarak ona yonelmeyi ve onu bilerek kastetmeyi bildirir. Dal cercevesi bu hedeflenmis kisiyi kastetme anlamini dogru ayirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalniz soyut isaret degil, kisinin sahsi, topluca cikma, kitap parcasini olusturan harf toplulugu ve gunes isigini de ayni ailede verir. Dal adi kullanilabilir, fakat tanim isaret cekirdegini bu adlasmis ve kalipli uzantilardan ayirmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Isaret cekirdegi korunur; kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlari buna bagli uzantilardir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mixed non-bare kapsam, yalniz ciplak isaret anlamini degil, kalipli kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlarini ayri facetlerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gorunen bir belirti veya isaret; bazi kalipli kullanimlarda kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitapta harflerden olusan parca ya da gunesin isigi icin de kullanilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi tanitan veya ona delalet eden gorunen belirtidir.
Kisinin sahsi, onun taninmasini saglayan belirti gibi dusunulerek ifade edilir.
Bir toplulugun eksiksiz butunu icin de kullanilir.
Kitapta harf toplulugundan olusan belirli parca anlamina gelir.
Gunes isigi, gunesin ayirt ettirici belirtisi gibi goruldugu icin bu alana baglanir.

Kaynak siniri, bu kullanimin yukleme konumunda oldugunu ve baska durum konumlarina tasinmadigini belirtir.
Uyarma veya sakindirma yapisi bu dayanak islevinin tipik kullanimidir.
